title: Husks Drop Sand Datapack
description: This datapack implements the ability for husks to drop sand
body:
This datapack modifies the vanillia loot table of husks to allow them to drop sand at similar odds as rotten flesh.

![husk loot table json](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dba7d404e440febc43f9bfbe247508876bc7205a.png)

The above image shows the modified loot table. This datapack adds nothing else and to remove it you should just use the in game commands (/datapack disable)
